summary: All 6 scope items from issue #850 are fully implemented and verified. (1) HealthCheck protocol, PipelineHealthContext, and HealthResult interfaces defined in orchestrator/health_checks/types.py and context.py with correct fields (status: HEALTHY/DEGRADED/FAILED, action: CONTINUE/FAIL_PIPELINE/ALERT). (2) Startup reconciliation and container monitor migrated as adapter checks (StartupStateCheck, ContainerLivenessCheck) without modifying original modules. (3) New Tier 1 checks implemented: PhaseOutputPresenceCheck detects issue-835 pattern (agents complete but no remote commits), StateConsistencyCheck verifies agent/container/contract consistency. (4) Tier 2 AgentInspectorCheck calls Claude API with assembled context (git log, diff, agent outputs, contract) and produces structured verdict with graceful degradation on API failures. (5) Trigger points wired into cli.py (STARTUP), container_monitor.py (RUNTIME_TICK), multi_agent.py (WAVE_COMPLETE), and routes/phases.py (PHASE_COMPLETE with 409 blocking on FAIL_PIPELINE). (6) Health check events (STARTED, COMPLETED, DEGRADED, FAILED) emitted via EventBus and surfaced through SSE; on-demand endpoint at GET /api/v1/pipelines/<id>/health. Trigger matrix matches issue specification. 419 health check tests pass. No regressions in orchestrator (1169 pass, 3 pre-existing failures), gateway (1523 pass), or shared (84 pass) test suites. Contract JSON has empty acceptance_criteria/phases fields but the issue scope is the authoritative source and all items are satisfied.
